result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, with one clear content defect: the promotional badge on the second 'Popular right now' card reads '−100%', which is an implausible discount value. Clipped carousel items at the right edge and the bottom-cut card are expected scrolling behaviour and are not reported.

issues.description: The discount badge on the second restaurant card (pizza image) in 'Popular right now' shows '−100%'. A 100% discount is implausible and suggests a data or formatting error (for example a wrong value or a miscalculated percentage), which could mislead users.
issues.suggestion: Check the source data and formatting logic for the promo badge. Show the correct discount (e.g. '−10%' or '−20%') and add validation to cap or hide out-of-range discount values.
